svg.title: AgentBuff stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, three.js. Backend: Node.js custom server, WebSocket proxy, Python agent bridge, MCP server and client. Data: PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM. AI: Bring your own AI key or login, 25+ AI providers. Ops: Docker per user, Midtrans, Nginx, Daily backups
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
Bring your own AI key or login
